components.name: theme
components.description: Shared foundation: Variant and Size enums and the buildClasses utility. Installed automatically with the first component.

components.name: button
components.description: DaisyUI button with variant, size, custom classes, and delegated HTML attributes (id, name, type, disabled).

components.name: card
components.description: DaisyUI card container with no variant or size, plus the mCardBody, mCardTitle, and mCardActions sub-components (all in Card.kt) mirroring card-body/card-title/card-actions.

components.name: navbar
components.description: DaisyUI navbar container with no variant or size, plus the mNavbarStart, mNavbarCenter, and mNavbarEnd slot sub-components (all in Navbar.kt) mirroring navbar-start/navbar-center/navbar-end.

components.name: drawer
components.description: DaisyUI drawer layout with a generated checkbox toggle, type-safe placement/open/responsive-open modifiers, and constrained mDrawerContent and mDrawerSide slots.

components.name: footer
components.description: DaisyUI footer container with no variant, size, or sub-components — a simple wrapper around the footer classes, styled by the utility classes the caller passes.

components.name: badge
components.description: DaisyUI badge with its own BadgeVariant palette (primary, secondary, accent, ghost, info, success, warning, error, neutral, outline), size, and custom classes.

components.name: alert
components.description: DaisyUI alert with its own AlertVariant palette (info, success, warning, error), custom classes, and a default role="alert" for assistive tech.

components.name: loading
components.description: DaisyUI loading indicator with its own LoadingType palette (spinner, dots, ring, ball, bars, infinity), size, and custom classes. Composable content for buttons and other components.

components.name: menu
components.description: DaisyUI menu navigation container with no variant or size, plus the mMenuItem and mMenuTitle sub-components (all in Menu.kt) for type-safe navigation links and section headers.

components.name: table
components.description: DaisyUI table with zebra modifier and component-specific TableSize for table sizing. Preserves normal HTML table structure (thead, tbody, tr, th, td).

components.name: tabs
components.description: DaisyUI tabs component for navigation and content switching. Supports radio-based tabs with content areas.

components.name: form
components.description: DaisyUI form components: mFormControl (form-control wrapper), mLabel (label container), mLabelText (label-text span), mInput (input with bordered/size modifiers), mFileInput (file input with bordered/variant/size modifiers), and mSelect (select with bordered/size modifiers). All expose raw HTML elements for native attribute access.

components.name: avatar
components.description: DaisyUI avatar and avatar group wrappers with type-safe online/offline and placeholder modifiers.

components.name: checkbox
components.description: DaisyUI checkbox input with type-safe variant, size, and indeterminate modifiers.

components.name: divider
components.description: DaisyUI divider with type-safe orientation, placement, and color modifiers.

components.name: stat
components.description: DaisyUI stats container with type-safe orientation and constrained stat, figure, title, value, description, and actions sub-components.

components.name: join
components.description: DaisyUI join group with type-safe orientation and constrained join item sub-component.
